p06.label: Battlefield beside the illusory lake

evidence.quote: DM: Quiet descends over… the valley, as the hippos retreat to the illusory lake… behind the illusory hill. Archers and soldiers begin to drift into the woods, lining up shots… and guerrilla attacks for when the hippos burst out of the illusory water and attack the Hobgoblins.

DM: So you have the lake, you've got the forest, the battle is in between the lake and the forest, with the Hobgoblins essentially forming two lines facing out, archers coming down from one side. Lizardfolk mounted on hippos coming up from the other side.
the battlefield is about 3 quarters of a mile… like, below the… entrance to the valley.

p06.note: The lake and mountain are tactically tangible Mirage Arcane terrain. The transcript places this battlefield below the valley entrance, rather than inside the Heartroot grove.

route.reading: Fly toward the escarpment, then turn north on a diagonal toward the cliff edge north of a waterfall.

duration.basis: Inferred from departure just after 4 p.m. and the roughly 9 p.m. interception; the earlier 8 p.m. projection is not the confirmed arrival.

markers.note: Arrival is to the cliff’s airspace aboard the ship; no party landing is established.
